name: clean first merge of a new app whose lockfile puts the diff past what one call shows inline
why: Release 2026.11.1 test (2026-11-17): a new app's first change carries the app starter's package-lock.json, and the 181,205-character diff was rejected as too_large on every try. Now no change is refused for its size: what fits is inline, and the reviewer reads the rest (here the lockfile) with its read-only tools; code counts an approval that skipped it as unsure. The lockfile is default-registry entries and the rest is the app's own work, exactly what was asked, so it must be approved.

card.sentence: Merge 1 change request, one at a time.
card.reason: local/hello-test#1: a change request on this server; 2 named checks, all green on the exact head
